verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at https://doc.anytype.io/llms.txt returning HTTP 200 with structured doc links, and Anytype also ships agent-oriented documentation (MCP server docs, AGENTS.md skill file, and an 'anytype-agents-skill' doc explicitly telling agents how to run scripts against Anytype data). This directly satisfies pointing an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: independent/community corroboration that agents actually consume llms.txt successfully, and no evidence of an OpenAPI/spec discovery alongside it (openapi probe 404s).
